players.product: antibody discovery and multispecific T-cell engager platform

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Carl Hansen on ABCL635 (anti-NK3R antibody for moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause): recruitment in the Phase II study in postmenopausal women accelerated through H1 and AbCellera completed enrollment and initial dosing of patients in June, 'well ahead of schedule'; a top-line readout was expected 'very soon', with 4-week data in all patients (no 12-week subset reported) after a single dose. The interim Phase I data reported last quarter showed robust and sustained target engagement in healthy male volunteers, no perceptible increase in liver enzymes across any of the patients, and testosterone suppression deeper than seen with the small molecules that lasted the entire dosing interval. His bar for success: a clean safety profile and a frequency response relative to placebo 'on the order of 20% at least' plus a reduction of at least two hot flashes per day; he called whether NK3R blockade in the median preoptic nucleus matters 'the key remaining scientific risk in the program'. Next steps if positive: late-stage development in menopause VMS and clinical studies in VMS associated with cancer treatment (breast and prostate cancer); he estimates probably over 1 million women in the U.S. alone are contraindicated and would benefit from a non-hormonal option.
quarterly_data.figure: enrollment and initial dosing completed in June; 4-week top-line data; response on the order of 20% at least vs placebo; reduction of at least two hot flashes per day; over 1 million women in the U.S.

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Carl Hansen on the rest of the pipeline: ABCL688 and ABCL386 continue through IND-enabling activities and are expected to enter Phase I/II studies in 2027. The Phase I trial of ABCL575 completed dosing and is on track for a readout in Q4; AbCellera intends to complete Phase I and currently has no plans to develop it past Phase I. AbCellera missed its goal of moving another program into IND-enabling activities in the first half of this year.
quarterly_data.figure: ABCL688 and ABCL386 Phase I/II in 2027; ABCL575 Phase I readout in Q4
